svg.title: Red Over Yellow
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/auctions/ecatalogue/2013/may-2013-contemporary-day-n08992/lot.174.html; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable study, not a facsimile.
